caption: The drawing displays two detailed graphite illustrations of spoons set against a light beige background. Both spoons are shown from a top-down perspective, aligned horizontally, one above the other. The upper spoon features a bordered handle with a twisted rope-like edge and the letters “LHT” engraved on the end of the handle. The lower spoon has a plain, slightly tapered handle that widens toward the end and displays a series of small rectangular hallmarks near the tip of the handle. Both spoons show shadowed, three-dimensional rendering with attention to metallic reflection. In the lower left corner, an inset box presents a smaller technical line drawing of the lower spoon with measurements indicated in inches. The right-hand side below the inset includes the written scale “SCALE: ¼ = 1” and a signature.
title: Silver Spoon
